title: Probe list row
description: One row of probes.csv. The probe list is the HITL artifact a human takes to the workbench to verify the pipeline's claims against the real PCB. CSV column order matches the 'required' order below.

priority.description: HIGH: power/ground or multi-sheet net. MED: AI low-confidence or ERC borderline. LOW: spot-checks.

reason.description: Why this net is on the list. e.g. 'junction dot in smudged region sheet 1 zone C5'

suggested_test.description: Concrete instrument procedure. e.g. 'DMM continuity U14C.6 to U13C.4 with board powered off'

status.description: Updated by the human during probing. 'contradicted' triggers a discrepancies.md entry.
